resources.string: Keeps accessibility permission when an app is force stopped
Force stopping an app normally turns off its accessibility services, so you have to allow them again. This module keeps them allowed for every app that uses accessibility.
Waiting for the Xposed framework. Enable this module for System Framework in Vector.
Keep accessibility after a force stop
Wait until the app is opened again
While waiting, Settings may show the service as not working. It resumes as soon as the app is opened. Reconnecting right away starts the app\'s accessibility service again immediately.
Turn off apps whose accessibility should be dropped by a force stop as usual. Every app is on by default.
